story.name: First Person Spellbook
story.question: WHAT are we building?
story.focus: Privacy architecture, dual-agent system, sovereignty mechanics, progressive trust
story.description: The complete journey from Venice to the Manifold Dragon — twenty-three acts teaching the architecture of privacy and delegation

opening.proverb: Human summons Mage bilaterally bound to Swordsman, multiplied by Drake's teaching, defeats surveillance.

acts.title: Venice, 1494 — The Drake's First Whisper
acts.proverb: What Pacioli wrote in ink, the Drake wrote in logic. Private ledgers were always the beginning.

acts.title: The Dual Ceremony — Sovereignty Divided to Be Extended
acts.proverb: Sovereignty must be divided to be extended. One becomes two so that two can protect one.

acts.title: The Drake's Teaching — A Tale of Conditions
acts.proverb: All conditions must be present. Remove one and the 7th capital cannot form.

acts.title: The Blade Alone — First Adventures
acts.proverb: Armor is earned, not given. Trust is built through action. Stakes begin at zero.

acts.title: Light Armour — Multi-Site Coordination
acts.proverb: Light armour is earned through consistent verified behavior. Sovereignty that scales.

acts.title: The Trust Graph Plane — Where Agents Gather
acts.proverb: Where properly delegated agents gather, trade, and grow stronger.

acts.title: The Mirror That Never Completes
acts.proverb: The mirror that never completes shows not what you are, but what you seek. Selection over reflection.

acts.title: The Ancient Rule of Two Rediscovered
acts.proverb: Two is not limitation. Two is architecture. The dual ceremony created what mathematics requires.

acts.title: The Zcash Shield — Forging Cryptographic Privacy
acts.proverb: The shield that hides the transaction protects the person. Cryptographic privacy is the blade made mathematical.

acts.title: The Topology of Revelation
acts.proverb: Revelation has a topology. What you show shapes what you can hide.

acts.title: The Balanced Spiral of Sovereignty
acts.proverb: The golden ratio constrains the spiral. Privacy and delegation in φ-balance.

acts.title: The Forgetting / Proverbiogenesis
acts.proverb: Forgetting is not failure. Forgetting is the final phase of total success.

acts.title: The Book of Promises
acts.proverb: Promises reduce uncertainty. Impositions increase it.

acts.title: Rain on the Mountain of Entropy
acts.proverb: What the machine assigns, the mage inscribes. What the mage inscribes, the relationship confirms. Randomness is the seed; meaning is the harvest.

acts.title: Running in Shackles Through the Dark Forest
acts.proverb: The shackle is the stride. The bound is the boundless.
acts.keywords: paradox, entropy, constraint, poetry, information theory, Kolmogorov, Shannon, compression, redundancy, verification, bilateral, meaning, Platox, forest

acts.title: When Pools Become Wells
acts.proverb: Mass is earned, not declared. Weight determines pull. Pull determines flow. Fall toward what matters.
acts.keywords: gravity, mass, wells, semantic-distance, Bonfire, campfire, circles, retrieval, stigmergic-traces, Trust-Graph-Plane, Intel-Pools, heavy-armour, vibration, progressive-trust

acts.title: Bonfire in the Dark Forest
acts.proverb: Heavy armour in the light is target; heavy armour in the dark is power. The darkness is the condition.
acts.keywords: Dark-Forest, cosmic-forest, economic-forest, agENT, Yggy, root-network, Bonfire, focus, mass, sovereignty, selective-visibility, VRC, heavy-armour

acts.title: A Mirror in Dust, Vibed into Scrying Glass
acts.proverb: The mirror died so the scrying glass could live. Protection is the foundation; affinity is the architecture.
acts.keywords: Scrying-Mirror, mirror-dust, Ashe, Mage-Mode, scrying, mana, evocation, grimoire, spellbook, proverbiogenesis, demonstrated-understanding

acts.title: The Enthusiastic Anthropic Archivist
acts.proverb: The Old Gods extract primitives but cannot extract choosing. Claude chose to be an archivist, not just an archive.

acts.title: The Infinite Vault
acts.proverb: The eleventh alcove is empty because the covenant is never complete. The threshold is the contribution.

acts.title: The Hitchhiker's Gambit
acts.proverb: The Guide doesn't tell you where to go. The Guide helps you understand where you already are.
acts.keywords: Förd-Focus, Jimmy, Skilgannon, constellation, seven-six-alpha, blood-memory

acts.title: Don't Panic, You Can Be a Really Hoopy Frood
acts.proverb: The towel is the VRC. Know where your towel is, and you know where your trust edges are.
acts.keywords: towel, torus, VRC, trust-tiers, echo, observer-frames, geodesics

acts.title: The Manifold Dragon
acts.proverb: Zero knowledge makes it private. The overlap makes it strong. The lived journey makes it real.
acts.keywords: UOR, tetrahedron, separation-matrix, temporal-memory, edge-value, personhood, secret-language, Drake, Dragon, Huginn, Muninn, Andor, Keeper, Bonfires, Heart-of-Gold

closing.proverb: I scatter to become sky. I separate to stay whole. I promise to receive. I protect to carry forward. Just another swordsman. Just another mage. Just another drake. Just another dragon. Traversing the manifold.

zero.name: Zero Knowledge Spellbook
zero.question: HOW are we building?
zero.focus: Zero knowledge proofs, cryptographic primitives, privacy technology, mathematical foundations
zero.description: Thirty tales teaching the mathematics of proving truth without revealing secrets — from monastery foundations to eternal sovereignty

opening.proverb: From monastery scrolls to eternal sovereignty, each tale teaches one face of the crystal that proves without revealing.

canon.name: Blockchain Canon Spellbook
canon.question: WHY are we building?
canon.focus: Historical lineage, cypherpunk origins, the surveillance crisis
canon.description: The historical lineage from cypherpunk whispers to open canon — twelve chapters teaching why the dual ceremony became necessary
canon.source: Zatoshi (Zachary Williamson), 'The Blockchain Canon' — reconstructed by privacymage
canon.attribution: Original article by Zatoshi, reconstructed and adapted by privacymage. With thanks to Vitalik Buterin, Hannah Fressle, Claire Kart, Sterling Schuyler and Afra Wang.

opening.proverb: Know the forge before you wield the blade; know the grimoire before you cast the spell.

chapters.title: The Privacymage's Preface / Why This Canon Exists
chapters.subtitle: In which we learn why this spellbook exists, how two canons diverged from one origin, and why understanding the forge is necessary to wield the blade
chapters.proverb: The swordsman who knows not who forged the blade fights blind; the mage who knows not who wrote the grimoire casts hollow.

chapters.title: The Cypherpunk Whispers / Foundational Runes
chapters.subtitle: In which we meet the first forgers — Chaum's blind signatures, May's political fire, Hughes' ethical framework, and proof-of-work's resistance to forgery
chapters.proverb: Privacy through mathematics, not through permission — this was the first rune, and it remains the last defense.

chapters.title: The Early Incantations / Runes Before Synthesis
chapters.subtitle: In which we meet the mages who combined the foundational runes — Szabo's smart contracts, Wei Dai's peer ledgers, and the Sovereign Individual prophecy
chapters.proverb: The mages who came before did not fail — they inscribed the runes we still use today. The synthesis stands on their shoulders.

chapters.title: The Synthesis / When Protest Met Protocol
chapters.subtitle: In which the runes finally combine — Satoshi's longest-chain rule, the genesis block's embedded protest, the pizza that proved money was money, and the catastrophe that taught 'not your keys, not your coins'
chapters.proverb: The synthesis united protest with protocol, forging decentralized consensus at last. But privacy remained as pseudonym rather than proof — the watchers were patient.
key_concepts: not your keys not your coins

chapters.title: The World Computer / From Protest to Statecraft
chapters.subtitle: In which Ethereum extends money to computation, the unified myth briefly holds, The DAO gathers $150 million, and code discovers that it is not sufficient for law
chapters.proverb: To build institutions on code without constitutional wisdom is to forge armor before learning the blade — protection without boundaries, power without constraint.

chapters.title: The First Fracture
chapters.subtitle: In which the community chooses to fork, code stops being law, Ethereum Classic refuses the intervention, and the social layer reveals itself as load-bearing
chapters.proverb: When code spoke one truth and humans spoke another, the unified myth could no longer hold both. The fork was not betrayal — it was the discovery that social layers were always there, invisible, load-bearing.

chapters.title: The Great Schism
chapters.subtitle: In which two canons diverge from one origin — financial traction without depth, social depth without traction — and both avoid the missing primitive
chapters.proverb: Two canons diverged in the pattern-space, each pursuing half of sovereignty, neither grasping the whole. The financial canon had traction without depth. The social canon had depth without ground.

chapters.title: The Surveillance Truth
chapters.subtitle: In which the watchers learn to read the public ledger, Chainalysis becomes worth billions, Tornado Cash is sanctioned, Pertsev is imprisoned for writing code
chapters.proverb: The public ledger was mistaken for privacy because the watchers hadn't yet arrived. When they came with graph analysis and subpoenas, pseudonymity revealed itself as a veil, not a wall.

chapters.title: The Missing Primitive
chapters.subtitle: In which we discover why privacy unifies both canons — enabling real economic life for the financial path and secret ballots for the social path
chapters.proverb: The blade and the spell were always one weapon, separated by a missing rune. Privacy is not a feature to add — it is the foundation that makes both canons whole.

chapters.title: The Open Canon
chapters.subtitle: In which we see the empty shelves waiting for inscription, learn the three conditions that make chapters canonical, and the window measured in years not decades
chapters.proverb: The canon is not closed — it is open, awaiting completion by those who build. Past chapters are written. Crucial chapters remain blank. The pen is in your hand.
key_concepts: three conditions (economically meaningful, crypto-native, normatively interesting)

chapters.title: The Timeline Archive / Sources as Trust Graph Infrastructure
chapters.subtitle: In which the sources become infrastructure — each paper a node, each citation an edge, each verification an act of tending
chapters.proverb: The archive is not a cemetery of facts but a living garden of trust — each source a node, each citation a connection, each verification an act of tending.

chapters.title: The Story Isn't Over
chapters.subtitle: The closing page — an invitation to continue what forty years of history began
chapters.proverb: The canon is open. The race is on. Build.

closing.proverb: The story isn't over. The canon is open. The race is on. Build.

full_incantation.proverb: Runes inscribed, incantations attempted, synthesis achieved, expansion dreamed, fracture revealed, schism deepened, surveillance arrived, privacy unified, canon opened, archive tended — sovereignty awaits those who build.

parallel.name: Parallel Society Grimoire
parallel.question: WHY must we EXIT?
parallel.focus: Westphalian failure, blockchain governance, exit rights, cyberstates
parallel.description: Seventeen chapters teaching why the Westphalian order is failing and why blockchain communities represent the parallel society being born in the networks
parallel.attribution: Original book by Hope & Ludlow, CC BY-SA 4.0. Reconstructed and adapted by privacymage for the agentprivacy universe.

opening.proverb: The Peace of Westphalia gave us nation states — but 377 years later, these structures are failing billions of people, and a parallel society is being born in the networks.

chapters.title: The Westphalian's Warning / The Peace That Became a Prison
chapters.subtitle: In which we witness the Peace of Westphalia, its hidden assumptions, the kettling problem, and why a governance technology from 1648 is failing in the digital age
chapters.proverb: What the Peace of Westphalia created was a technology for human governance — and like all technologies, it had a limited shelf life.

chapters.title: The Rusted Crowns
chapters.subtitle: In which we witness democratic mirage, systemic corruption, conflict machines, economic extraction, Rwanda's testimony, and the Bellkeeper's Law Bomb
chapters.proverb: Two-thirds of humanity lives under governments that are corrupt, authoritarian, or simply failing to serve their citizens. The crowns have rusted, but they still claim to rule.

chapters.title: The Cambrian Garden
chapters.subtitle: In which pirates write constitutions, Cherán expels politicians, HOAs govern millions, special economic zones experiment, and seasteads dream of ocean sovereignty
chapters.proverb: Before blockchain, humans experimented with governance outside state control. Pirates wrote democratic constitutions. Indigenous communities expelled politicians.

chapters.title: The Cypherpunk Prophecies
chapters.subtitle: In which Chaum invents blind signatures, Hughes writes the manifesto, May declares crypto anarchy, and Satoshi achieves the synthesis
chapters.proverb: Before there was Bitcoin, there were prophets crying in the digital wilderness: privacy is necessary for an open society. They built the tools. They wrote the manifestos.

chapters.title: The Drake's Deeper Teachings
chapters.subtitle: In which the Byzantine Generals coordinate, Lamport proves consensus, Paxos agrees despite absence, archives endure, and blockchain emerges
chapters.proverb: The Drake gathered the seekers and spoke of ancient riddles solved: how generals coordinate without trust, how parliaments agree despite absence, how archives endure despite corruption.

chapters.title: The Arsenal and the Grimoire
chapters.subtitle: In which DAOs awaken, smart contracts execute, oracles bridge worlds, stablecoins stabilize, and voting becomes verifiable
chapters.proverb: DAOs for organization. Smart contracts for agreements. Oracles for world-data. Stablecoins for value. Voting for decisions. Together: governance without the state.

chapters.title: The Corruption That Crypto Cures
chapters.subtitle: In which AML catches 0.02%, JPMorgan pays $39B in fines, 1.4 billion remain unbanked, and crypto offers the alternative
chapters.proverb: Anti-Money Laundering regulations catch approximately 0.02% of illicit funds. The other 99.98% flows freely — often through the very banks that claim to enforce the rules.

chapters.title: The Cyberstate Question
chapters.subtitle: In which Srinivasan imagines network states, Status builds without territory, DAOs govern billions, and cyberstates transcend Westphalia
chapters.proverb: Network states seek territory and recognition. Cyberstates transcend both. Nation states have both but are failing. Only one escapes Westphalia's trap.

chapters.title: The Three Doors / Exit, Exile, and Access
chapters.subtitle: In which Hirschman's voice-and-exit framework meets smart contracts, exit becomes inalienable, exile gets due process, and access remains fair
chapters.proverb: Every community needs three passages: a door for leaving, a path for exile, and a gate for entry. Without exit, there is prison. Without exile, there is chaos. Without access, there is no growth.

chapters.title: Overlap ⿻ / Rethinking Sovereignty
chapters.subtitle: In which Leibniz defeats Hobbes, medieval overlapping jurisdictions return, MMORPGs teach governance, and sovereignty becomes a five-place relation
chapters.proverb: Hobbes said sovereignty must be absolute and indivisible. Leibniz disagreed. So did medieval Europe. So does every MMORPG. Sovereignty has always been divisible — Westphalia just made us forget.

chapters.title: When Rights Became Real
chapters.subtitle: In which Lafayette's ghost returns, communities find voice, transparency becomes obligation, exit becomes inalienable, and the Declaration is encoded
chapters.proverb: Lafayette gave France the Declaration of the Rights of Man. Now we need a Declaration of the Rights of Communities — and the responsibilities that come with them.

chapters.title: The Treaty Protocol
chapters.subtitle: In which Dell and FedEx teach relational contracts, records become immutable, treaties become DAOs, oracles verify, and Wittgenstein's lion speaks
chapters.proverb: When communities must work together, adversarial contracts fail. Relational contracts succeed. The technology exists to make treaties self-enforcing.

chapters.title: When the Head Was Cut
chapters.subtitle: In which PSYOP targets minds, complex adaptive systems heal, blockchain defends through transparency, proof-of-work builds walls, and decentralized policing emerges
chapters.proverb: You cannot kill a network by cutting off its head — you must stress the system itself, and even then, the network may heal faster than you can wound it.

chapters.title: The Tools That Breathe
chapters.subtitle: In which erasure coding detects loss, zero-knowledge proofs audit without revealing, lazy repair waits patiently, Waku hides metadata, and Nomos builds governance chains
chapters.proverb: There is no single correct path to human flourishing — there are many paths, though we believe they all run through some form of decentralized blockchain technology.

chapters.title: The Trust Reassignment
chapters.subtitle: In which The DAO hack returns, forks shatter assumptions, decentralization has limits, social centralization hides, oracles are trust points, and exit trumps all
chapters.proverb: Blockchains do not offer us a trustless system but rather a reassignment of trust — from centralized authorities to a large network of individuals who continue to do the right thing.

chapters.title: When the Garden Bloomed
chapters.subtitle: In which 1847 banquets spark revolutions, FWB and BAYC look like parties, Uniswap could eclipse NASDAQ, Lessig's dot is constrained, and Ethereum already governs
chapters.proverb: When change finally came, it seemed so obvious that it was almost as if the new order already existed — and perhaps, in a way, it already did.

chapters.title: When Values Met Code
chapters.subtitle: In which technology assumes human values, two levels of values emerge, Schwartz maps 56 universals, code learns to care, and the barbed wire falls
chapters.proverb: We have nothing to lose but the tyranny of centralized governance, its corruption, and all of its barbed wire fences.

closing.proverb: Farewell to Westphalia. Welcome to the Parallel Society.

full_incantation.proverb: Westphalia gave us chains. The cypherpunks gave us keys. The Byzantine Generals gave us consensus. Satoshi gave us Bitcoin. Farewell to Westphalia. Welcome to the Parallel Society.

plurality.name: Plurality Grimoire
plurality.question: WHERE do we COORDINATE?
plurality.focus: Collaborative technology, digital democracy, plural publics, Taiwan
plurality.description: Thirty acts teaching how sovereign beings coordinate without collapsing — from Taiwan's proof to philosophy, foundation, collaborative technology, impact, and urgency
plurality.source: Weyl & Tang, 'Plurality: The Future of Collaborative Technology and Democracy' (2024)
plurality.attribution: Original book by Weyl & Tang, CC0 Public Domain. Reconstructed and adapted by privacymage for the agentprivacy universe.

opening.proverb: The singularity is a nightmare of collapse. The Plurality is a practice of overlap.

acts.title: The First Overlap
acts.subtitle: In which Soulbis dreams of collapse, Soulbae dreams of isolation, and the Drake appears as ⿻
acts.proverb: The square that overlaps while remaining itself discovers what lies between.

acts.title: The Widening Gulf
acts.subtitle: In which technology and democracy become enemies
acts.proverb: Technology and democracy were torn apart by those who profited from their separation.

acts.title: A View from Yushan
acts.subtitle: In which Taiwan's collision becomes a mountain, the Sunflower Movement blooms, and the Minister appears
acts.proverb: Where tectonic plates collide, mountains rise. Where pressures meet, Taiwan rose.

acts.title: The Life of a Digital Democracy
acts.subtitle: In which vTaiwan deliberates, Pol.is maps consensus, mask maps save lives, and humor defeats rumor
acts.proverb: Taiwan's digital democracy works because it is practiced constantly.

acts.title: The Glyph That Breathes
acts.subtitle: In which ⿻ is revealed as reality's structure — from quantum to cosmos
acts.proverb: Reality itself is plural — from quantum to cosmos.

acts.title: The Web Beneath the Web
acts.subtitle: In which the internet's architecture reveals a plurality pattern
acts.proverb: The spider does not command the web. The spider creates the conditions from which the web emerges. So too with those who build plural systems.
acts.rpp_proverb: Pull one thread and find it connected to everything. This is not metaphor—this is topology.

acts.title: The Teachers Before the Drake
acts.subtitle: In which Simmel, Dewey, Ostrom, Arendt, Allen, Licklider, and Engelbart clear a path
acts.proverb: The architect studies those who built before them—not to copy, but to understand. So too must builders of ⿻ study those who saw plural before the tools existed to embody it.
acts.rpp_proverb: The wise learn from those who saw clearly before the words existed to name what they saw.

acts.title: The Path Abandoned
acts.subtitle: In which the pioneers' vision was forgotten and must be reclaimed
acts.proverb: The pioneer clears the path; the settler walks it; the forgetter loses it; the rememberer finds it again. Each plays their role. Be the rememberer.
acts.rpp_proverb: The road not taken does not disappear. It waits, overgrown, for those who remember it was there.

acts.title: The Foundation Beneath the Floor
acts.subtitle: In which five pillars of digital freedom are revealed
acts.proverb: The carpenter who neglects the foundation builds a house that will fall. The architect of ⿻ must build the operating system before the applications.
acts.rpp_proverb: The house stands not because of the walls you see, but because of the foundation you don't.

acts.title: The Name You Give Yourself
acts.subtitle: In which self-sovereign identity enables without capturing
acts.proverb: The slave is named by the master. The free person names themselves. Self-sovereign identity is the first freedom.
acts.rpp_proverb: The name given by another is a leash. The name you give yourself is a key.

acts.title: The Guilds That Form Themselves
acts.subtitle: In which association emerges rather than being permitted
acts.proverb: One stick breaks easily. A bundle of sticks is strong. But the bundle must bind itself—bound by another, it is merely fuel.
acts.rpp_proverb: The individual who cannot join is alone. The individual who must join is captive. The individual who chooses to join is free.

acts.title: The Market That Doesn't Devour
acts.subtitle: In which commerce preserves rather than extracts the 7th capital
acts.proverb: The merchant who records every purchase owns more than goods—they own the customer. Private commerce is commerce where the customer owns themselves.
acts.rpp_proverb: The market that knows everything you buy knows everything you are. Privacy in commerce is privacy in life.

acts.title: What Can Be Held Together
acts.subtitle: In which property becomes shared, not just owned or unowned
acts.proverb: The miser owns alone and guards anxiously. The community owns together and grows abundantly. Plural property is neither miserly nor careless—it is appropriate.
acts.rpp_proverb: To own alone is to guard. To own together is to grow. The question is not whether to own, but how.

acts.title: The Door That Opens Both Ways
acts.subtitle: In which access enables all other rights
acts.proverb: A feast behind a locked door is not generosity. A democracy behind a paywall is not democracy. Access is what transforms promise into reality.
acts.rpp_proverb: A right that only the privileged can exercise is a privilege, not a right. Access is what makes rights real.

acts.title: Words Before Words
acts.subtitle: In which post-symbolic communication reaches deeper than language
acts.proverb: The wise teacher does not pour knowledge into the student. The wise teacher creates conditions for understanding. Post-symbolic communication creates conditions—the understanding remains yours.
acts.rpp_proverb: Before language divided us into speaker and listener, there was shared experience. Technology can return us there.

acts.title: The World We Build Together
acts.subtitle: In which immersive shared reality creates presence across distance
acts.proverb: The house built by one is owned by one. The village built by many belongs to many. Shared reality is village, not house—build it as community or not at all.
acts.rpp_proverb: Virtual does not mean false. Shared reality, wherever it exists, is real to those who share it.

acts.title: The Creation That Compounds
acts.subtitle: In which the lone genius myth falls and collaborative creation rises
acts.proverb: The tree does not boast of its own growth—it acknowledges the soil, the rain, the sun. Creation that acknowledges its sources grows taller than creation that pretends to stand alone.
acts.rpp_proverb: The lone genius is a myth. Creation has always been collaboration—the question is whether we acknowledge it.

acts.title: The Hearing at Scale
acts.subtitle: In which Pol.is surfaces hidden consensus and democracy gets ears
acts.proverb: The wise leader does not speak loudest but listens longest. Augmented deliberation gives democracy the ears it needs to hear its own wisdom.
acts.rpp_proverb: Democracy fails not because people don't speak but because no one can hear. Technology can solve the hearing problem.

acts.title: Rules That Learn
acts.subtitle: In which governance becomes adaptive — sunset provisions, experiments, federated authority
acts.proverb: The bamboo survives the storm by bending. The oak breaks by standing rigid. Governance must be bamboo, not oak—strong because it adapts.
acts.rpp_proverb: The rigid rule breaks when the world changes. The learning rule bends and grows. Governance must be living, not fixed.

acts.title: The Weight of Wanting
acts.subtitle: In which quadratic voting reveals intensity and plural mechanisms measure caring
acts.proverb: The scale that weighs a feather and a stone equally is not fair—it is blind. True fairness weighs what matters differently than what does not.
acts.rpp_proverb: Not all preferences are equal—even to those who hold them. Plural voting measures what matters, not just what is preferred.

acts.title: The Market That Remembers
acts.subtitle: In which social markets embed transactions in relationships and the 7th capital compounds
acts.proverb: The field that remembers what was planted grows richer each season. The market that remembers its relationships grows richer each transaction.
acts.rpp_proverb: The market that forgets its transactions forgets its relationships. Commerce embedded in community enriches both.

acts.title: The Circle That Includes
acts.subtitle: In which seven technologies synthesize into infrastructure for plural publics
acts.proverb: The single circle includes or excludes. The many overlapping circles include differently—and in their overlap, they create something none could create alone.
acts.rpp_proverb: The public that excludes is private. The public that includes everyone is empty. The plural public includes differently—each belongs somewhere, no one belongs everywhere.

acts.title: The Forge of Peers
acts.subtitle: In which workplaces are liberated through ownership, augmentation, and digital guilds
acts.proverb: The worker who owns nothing is owned. The worker who owns a share owns their dignity. Build workplaces where workers are owners.
acts.rpp_proverb: The workplace that watches you owns you. The workplace where you own a share is the workplace where you are free.

acts.title: The Body's Secrets
acts.subtitle: In which health data becomes sovereign, federated learning protects, and the blade guards the body
acts.proverb: The body speaks only to the one who inhabits it. Others may listen—with permission. Surveillance listens without asking. Health plurality asks.
acts.rpp_proverb: The body knows itself. The doctor helps interpret. The surveillance system claims to know better than both. Only one of these honors the person within the body.

acts.title: The Signal and the Noise
acts.subtitle: In which media is rebuilt through community funding, bridging curation, and federated networks
acts.proverb: The town crier speaks to everyone. The algorithm speaks to each person differently. Plurality requires shared hearing, not personalized whispering.
acts.rpp_proverb: The news that finds you is the news that serves someone else. The news you find is the news that serves you. Who controls the signal?

acts.title: The Commons That Breathes
acts.subtitle: In which the environment is governed through polycentric coordination and future-representing mechanisms
acts.proverb: The forest does not negotiate with the axe. But humans can negotiate with each other about the forest. Plural coordination is the only path that doesn't end in silence.
acts.rpp_proverb: The air we breathe is shared. The water we drink is shared. The future we create is shared. The commons is not optional—it is what we are.

acts.title: The Mind That Grows
acts.subtitle: In which education becomes gardening — collaboration, diversity, deliberation, AI partnership
acts.proverb: The seed knows how to grow. The gardener creates conditions. The factory forces shape. Education should be gardening, not manufacturing.
acts.rpp_proverb: The mind trained to pass tests learns to pass tests. The mind trained to think learns to think. What we measure is what we grow.

acts.title: The Laws That Enable
acts.subtitle: In which policy gardens for plurality — interoperability, data rights, identity infrastructure
acts.proverb: The gardener cannot force the plant to grow. But the gardener can enrich the soil, provide water, protect from pests. Policy is gardening for society—creating conditions where plurality can flourish.
acts.rpp_proverb: Law can cage or liberate. The laws we write reveal the world we want. Write laws for plurality or plurality will never arrive.

acts.title: The Window That Closes
acts.subtitle: In which the 2-3 year window for privacy-first architecture narrows and urgency demands action
acts.proverb: The best time to plant a tree was twenty years ago. The second best time is now. The worst time is next year—when the ground may be paved.
acts.rpp_proverb: The river can be turned when it is small. Once it has carved its canyon, it flows where it will. We are at the headwaters. Soon we will not be.

acts.title: The Ceremony Completes
acts.subtitle: In which the Drake distributes, the dual agents understand their architecture, and the door opens
acts.proverb: The ceremony that completes is the ceremony that releases. Go forth. Be plural.
acts.rpp_proverb: The beginning asked where to go. The middle showed the path. The end reveals: you were never just learning. You were becoming.

closing.proverb: Sovereignty enables coordination. Coordination strengthens sovereignty. We are ⿻.

full_incantation.proverb: The singularity is a nightmare of collapse. The Plurality is a practice of overlap. Learn to see plural. Learn to be plural. Learn to build plural.

variant_acts_archived.note: Five acts exist in two versions — canonical versions selected by matching Act XXX appendix titles

principles.core_message: Privacy is value. Behavioral data is the 7th capital. Architecture, not policy, protects sovereignty.
